items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-30
items.q: he spoke of President Eisenhower being just as close as Dick and I

ctx.x: a colonist in what is it? Saigon? Saigon wrote he wrote us a wonderful write-up the next day after our appearance there and I said Addy we ought to sit down and write him a thank you note for that because it was so well written it was in the newspaper so we wrote him a card and we got an answer right back and he said well he said I want you to tell and he spoke of President Eisenhower being just as close as Dick and I he says tell your friend President Eisenhower when you get back that sending you folks over here…
I'll just turn this off again pleasure pleasure
